fact_previews: The project is raising funds to manufacture Kora AI, a wall-mounted home assistant.
Kora AI runs on-device, agentic AI models to help families coordinate schedules, reminders, shopping lists, and smart-home automations.
The project is developing AI technology that powers Kora, including natural-language understanding, task-planning, and personalized reminder engines.
Training data for Kora AI comes from a mix of publicly available, open-license datasets and proprietary data created in-house.
No copyrighted works or personal data are used without explicit, prior consent.
